text: And now it's time for the Fisherman's Dream Boat Challenge update. We only had one entry this week and that was by Long Island subscriber Robert Diperio of East Islip. He entered a 2.36 lb sea robin weighed in at Chasin' Tails Bait and Tackle and places sixth in the sea robin category. The leaderboard now [music] looks like this. Brian Zambreski is down a point at 13. Amir Rajab Paul still standing in second at 17 points. Tan Bu holds on to the lead with 23 points.
